-- Compiled proof, equivalent to #print DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.is_least_fixpoint
theorem DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.is_least_fixpoint :
∀ [inst : DY.BytesFunctor] [inst_1 : DY.ExecTraceTypes] [inst_2 : DY.BaseAttackerKnowledge]
  [inst_3 : DY.AttackerKnowledge] (pred : DY.Bytes → Prop) (b : DY.Bytes) (tr : DY.ExecTrace),
  DY.AttackerKnowledge.attackerKnowledge.Implies pred →
    (DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.baseKnowledge tr).Implies pred → b.AttackerKnows tr → pred b
:=
fun [DY.BytesFunctor] [DY.ExecTraceTypes] [DY.BaseAttackerKnowledge] [DY.AttackerKnowledge] pred b tr pf1 pf2 =>
  DY.Fixpoint.mkLeastFixpoint_is_least (DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.attackerKnowledge✝ tr).pred
    (DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.attackerKnowledge✝ tr).pred_isMonotonic pred
    (Eq.mpr (id (forall_congr fun x => implies_congr Fin.exists_fin_two._simp_1 (Eq.refl (pred x)))) fun b =>
      have this := pf1 b;
      have this_1 := pf2 b;
      DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.is_least_fixpoint._proof_1_3✝ pred tr b this this_1)
    b
